verdict.rationale: Kit can be driven without its UI through the V4 REST API. API keys are explicitly offered "for automating simple tools and integrations for your own account," which suits non-interactive scripts. Bulk and async processing with callbacks, cursor pagination, webhooks and a remote MCP server for read/write account access round this out. Using it in CI still means writing your own HTTP scripts, and no machine-readable spec was found (the OpenAPI probe returned 404). Missing for 10: an official CLI or SDK for scripted use, CI-specific documentation or examples, a published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI usage.
